title: app launch is ok but another screen is on top
symptom: launch · relaunch · back succeed but the screen does not change (e.g. another session's Google login)
cause: Another app (e.g. the com.google.android.gms login) holds the top of a shared emulator. back may not work
fix: Check directly with adb shell dumpsys window | grep mCurrentFocus
Check owner in device list to see if someone else uses the device; if so, ask first
If it does not clear, launch_cli.py device reboot --cold (about 35 s)
